items.title: 提供运行环境
items.text: 微信等宿主加载小程序代码，提供导航、组件以及允许使用的设备能力。小程序自己的页面和业务逻辑仍需要开发。

items.title: 按平台规则运行
items.text: 原生微信小程序常用 WXML 写结构、WXSS 写样式、JavaScript 写行为。其他平台的标签、能力与发布规则可能不同。

modules.title: 打开页面，就代表预约成功了吗
modules.text: 能打开页面不代表预约已保存。订单记录仍需要后端或云服务；能否使用某项能力、能否正式上线还要符合目标平台的要求。

lessonPractice.title: 两个预约页面长得一样，一个作为微信小程序打开，一个通过浏览器网址打开。区别主要在哪里？

options.label: 加载和运行页面的环境不同
options.feedback: 外观相同也可以运行在不同环境里；应看它是宿主内的小程序，还是通过网址运行的网页。

options.label: 页面有没有“预约”按钮
options.feedback: 预约是功能，按钮的存在不能确定运行环境。

options.label: 顾客是不是通过扫码进入
options.feedback: 二维码可以指向小程序，也可以指向网页，要看打开后的环境。

en.title: Two booking screens look alike. One opens as a WeChat mini program, the other by a browser URL. What distinguishes them?

options.label: The environment that loads and runs the screen
options.feedback: The host mini program environment and browser runtime differ even when the design matches.

options.feedback: A booking button describes a function, not the runtime.

options.label: Whether customers entered through a QR code
options.feedback: A QR code can lead to either runtime; inspect what it opens.

modules.title: What does the host app provide?

items.title: An environment for the app
items.text: The host loads the mini program code and provides navigation, components, and supported device capabilities.

items.title: Its own development rules
items.text: A native WeChat mini program uses WXML for structure, WXSS for styles, and JavaScript for behavior. Other platforms have their own conventions.

modules.title: Does opening the page mean a booking was saved?
modules.text: Opening the page does not prove a booking was saved. Saving records still needs a backend or cloud service, and platform permissions and release requirements must be checked separately.

distinctions.label: Mobile website
distinctions.text: Runs as a website in a browser. A page inside WeChat can also be a website, so the WeChat window alone is insufficient.

distinctions.label: Native app
distinctions.text: Installed as its own app. A mini program uses a host app and its supported components and APIs.
